hypotheses: Dyadic complex normalized Fourier, all stages and interstage permutation factors measured/charged in one coordinate order.
implication: If sum q(S_i)+sum q(P_i)<=N/4 then operator error>=delta_N; exact representation needs budget>=N/4+1.
counterexample_or_boundary: Half-swap permutation has q=N/2 but O(N) data movement, so this is not a runtime bound.

hypotheses: Independently routed bounded-separator inverse sum; target D_L U D_R with invertible diagonal scalings.
implication: Exact bounds unchanged; absolute approximation gaps multiply by min|D_L|min|D_R|, relative op gap at least unscaled gap/(kappa(D_L)kappa(D_R)).
counterexample_or_boundary: Dense preconditioning may destroy endpoint grammar; condition number alone omits absolute scale.

hypotheses: Abelian2-group Fourier target; final separator rectangle side m odd; rank budget R=qr.
counterexample_or_boundary: Only odd final m; not automatically a sharper all-N cutoff. N64 m21 increases stable-rank ceiling7 to8.

hypotheses: Dyadic3-stage factorization satisfying C04 one-affine endpoint, with explicitly charged same-order permutations.
implication: Both discrepancy K>=c logN-2 and routing budget q(P1)+q(P2)>=N/4+1-(r1+r2+r3) hold.
counterexample_or_boundary: These inequalities cannot be freely added into a stronger rank sum; large routing cut rank is not large arithmetic cost.

hypotheses: Q_h=I-alpha P_h on a perfect binary tree; 0<alpha<1/sqrt2.
implication: Uniform condition number with unbounded optimized exact separation rank coexists with tree half-separator size1.
counterexample_or_boundary: Exact ranks do not lower-bound tolerance-dependent numerical ranks; remote ancestor entries decay as alpha^distance.

hypotheses: C01 target is a fixed5x5 chirp-resolvent restriction; C02 target is dyadic Fourier and F018 target flat unitary.
implication: No new combined lower bound follows without a target-preserving transformation and closure of summand grammar.
counterexample_or_boundary: The full B_N has only>=3 from restriction; block exact3 cannot be promoted to full family or Fourier speedup.

hypotheses: Fixed A,C invertible; B all nonzero; three-column minor lift injective; unscaled monomial norm.
implication: Improved beta_N all-gauge operator gap, factor sqrt(N+1) over source.
counterexample_or_boundary: s,b*,M_P and inverse norms may depend badly on N; fixed-stage gap does not exclude all wirings.
